items.value: Oh... I kind of slept, but then again, I didn't. And that storm happened at the worst possible time.
Join the Order, and by the age of 30 you could end up with bad knees and arthritis.
Who's breaking in there at such an early hour?
Supreme Healing! Supreme Healing! Supreme Healing!
Mm... my head hurts...
Oh, my grandson! Are you all right? Alive? I'm sorry, I was so scared I overestimated my strength...
It's okay, grandma... thanks for fixing it, everything's fine...
Are you sure? Because, you know, I feel like something's wrong.
Yes, everything is so! Everything is fine. I just came here to relax.
Oh... come on, tell me, how are things going at the Order? Is everything okay?
Yes...
Oh, I knew it, it's bad. After all, the highest healing heals the body, not the soul.
Yes, everything is fine with me. I'm just... tired, I guess.
Yeah, he's tired! He's even gotten the floors dirty! Come on, you know, change your clothes first! There are clean clothes in the closet, take them, the whole parquet floor is dirty, you idiot!
Grandma, I haven't been home for fifteen years, everything here is no longer enough for me!
Whew! Fifteen years! You said it like that's a long time. Never mind, grandma'll take care of it now.
There! Everything's ready, and you were worried! Come on, take off those armor of yours, and I'll clean up in the meantime.
Done. But I won't take off my helmet - that's the way.
Excellent. Now go get some fresh air, the weather is so wonderful outside! And don't come home before lunch!
Oh, I hate portals! Damn it! Lich take it!
Hmm, did Grandma clean it all up already? Or did Larisa do it...
Sometimes I regret that I didn't run after my father then.
A wooden training sword that my father received from my grandmother as a child and later gave to me.
He gave it to me right after his promotion to Mithril Knight. I didn't see my father again until my Golden Knight initiation ceremony.
I wish I hadn't joined the Order.
